in_marathi.name: Pandi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pandi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Pandi refers to Lord Kubera, the God of wealth. He is also known as the king of Alakapuri, a paradise in the Himalayas.

in_bengali.name: Pandi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Wealth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Pandi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Pandi refers to Lord Kubera, the God of wealth. He is also known as the king of Alakapuri, a paradise in the Himalayas.
